name: 3D bar chart
description: Three.js data chart on a transparent background: from a label:value list, a base plate draws out and rounded 3D bars rise one after another (outCubic) with value labels counting up above them and category labels below; one bar (the largest, or the one you pick) is in the accent colour, the others muted, with soft shadows and a gentle orbiting camera. Use for KPIs, quarter-over-quarter growth, survey results and comparisons in explainer, finance and pitch videos (3–8 bars; 16:9 and 9:16).
